title: The 4 Best Dehumidifiers for Small Bedrooms
h1: The 4 Best Dehumidifiers for Small Bedrooms
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for dehumidifiers for small bedrooms, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dehumidifiers for small bedrooms using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Midea Cube 35-Pint Smart Dehumidifier with Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 35-pint-per-day rating, covers up to 3,500 sq ft, Wi-Fi control via the MideaAir app, works with Alexa, Lift-and-twist Cube design for compact nested storage.
strengths: Nested Cube form factor takes up less floor space next to furniture than a boxy unit
App control lets you check the bedroom's humidity from another room without walking in
limitations: Costs more than the Vremi or TOSOT for a bedroom-scale need
35-pint capacity is more than most single bedrooms actually require
Learning the Cube's lift-and-twist mechanism takes a try or two
features: 35-pint-per-day rating, covers up to 3,500 sq ft
Wi-Fi control via the MideaAir app, works with Alexa
Lift-and-twist Cube design for compact nested storage
Draws as little as 512 watts at 50% RH

products.name: Vremi 50-Pint Dehumidifier for 4,500 Sq Ft Spaces
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day rating, more capacity than a typical bedroom needs, 1.8-gallon tank with full-tank auto shut-off, Adjustable humidistat and 24-hour timer.
strengths: Lowest typical price of the units in this list
Caster wheels make it easy to roll between a bedroom and a closet or nursery
Adjustable humidistat lets you dial in a comfortable overnight target
limitations: Runs louder than the Midea Cube on comparable settings per owner reports
50-pint capacity is oversized for a single small bedroom
Larger footprint than the Cube in its nested position
features: 50-pint-per-day rating, more capacity than a typical bedroom needs
Built-in caster wheels for easy repositioning

products.name: TOSOT 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Internal Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day rating for up to 4,500 sq ft, Internal pump lifts water up to 15 feet through an included hose, 52-decibel peak sound level.
strengths: 52dB peak volume is reasonably quiet for a 50-pint unit
Pump lets you drain directly into an ensuite bathroom sink without hand-emptying a bucket
Auto-restart keeps settings intact after a power blip overnight
limitations: 50-pint capacity and footprint are larger than most bedrooms need
Owner reports note compressor longevity issues after 2 to 3 years of heavy use
features: 50-pint-per-day rating for up to 4,500 sq ft
Internal pump lifts water up to 15 feet through an included hose

products.name: Frigidaire FHDD3534Y1 35-Pint Wi-Fi Dehumidifier
limitations: 1.7-gallon bucket fills quickly in damp rooms
App setup required for smart features

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
